Revised to introduce a progression of guilt (as described in the game tutorial) tied to reasoned or instinctive internalization of slavery (credit to utterlyjunky for suggesting a progression and developing the formula) ! Instead of being essentially random with hard-coded fixed upper limits for each interaction, the highest level of guilt that can be felt by a slave is now capped by a max_guilt internal variable. Interactions can set upper bounds on the maximum amount of guilt they could possibly give to a slave (although many will not). For example, a comparatively "minor" violation like cumming with no-orgasm rule could be limited to 3 guilt even for a perfectly devoted slave. Meanwhile, a new slave with an uninitialized max_guilt would feel the minimum guilt (1) even for a "severe" infraction. I considered even letting disobedient slaves feel no guilt at all, but many texts in the game are written assuming that guilt is awarded (almost all of the interaction refusal texts, for example), so I kept the minimum at 1 for now. ! ! JO9 MOD START MEIKI_CHECKS_V1
! Numeric result only: 0 or 1. No actor/session values are changed.
! Calls below are required dependencies; block markers are provenance, not removal instructions.
result = 0
! useless START CHECK_AGE | existing additional checks
! args1: age
if $args[0] = 'age':
 if args[1] = CONST_INT['young_age'] or args[1] = CONST_INT['milf_age']: result = 1
end
! useless END CHECK_AGE
! useless START CHECK_ACTOR | existing additional checks
! args1..8: state, age, fear, domini_dictum, neg_raped, neg_disgust, res, sex_acceptance
if $args[0] = 'actor':
 if args[1] = CONST_INT['slave_exist'] and func('jo9_meiki_checks', 'age', args[2]) = 1 and args[3] = 0 and args[4] = 0 and args[5] = 0 and args[6] = 0 and args[7] >= 0 and args[8] > 0: result = 1
end
! useless END CHECK_ACTOR
! useless START CHECK_DIRECT | existing additional checks
! args1..2: diligence, actor check result
if $args[0] = 'direct':
 if args[1] > 0 and args[2] = 1: result = 1
end
! useless END CHECK_DIRECT
! useless START CHECK_TRANSITION | existing additional checks
! args1..3: interaction_type, diligence, actor check result
if $args[0] = 'transition':
 if $args[1] ! 'rape' and $args[1] ! 'torture' and args[2] > 0 and args[3] = 1: result = 1
end
! useless END CHECK_TRANSITION
! useless START CHECK_GROUP | existing additional checks
! args1..4: slave diligence, assistant diligence, two actor check results
if $args[0] = 'group':
 if min(args[1], args[2]) > 0 and args[3] = 1 and args[4] = 1: result = 1
end
! useless END CHECK_GROUP
! useless START CHECK_COMPANION | existing additional checks
! args1: slave_les_txt5; existing literal values retained
if $args[0] = 'companion':
 if $args[1] = '젊은' or $args[1] = '밀프': result = 1
end
! useless END CHECK_COMPANION
! useless START CHECK_SESSION_ROUTE | existing additional checks
